visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long black hair, wearing a white and grey-pink shirt, stands in a room with a dark geometric-patterned wall. She smiles and gestures broadly with both hands as she speaks directly to the camera. Behind her, shelves hold various colorful figurines and small objects. (2) A shot of an infant lying on a colorful activity mat with hanging toys. The baby kicks at a motorized red car that moves along a track attached to the gym bars. (3) Close-up on the baby looking at the red car moving on the track. The background is a warm-toned wooden floor. (4) A blue elephant-shaped toy is held over a sink. Water flows from its trunk, causing a yellow water-wheel attachment to spin rapidly. (5) A green toy snail on wheels moves across a wooden floor; its shell rotates as it travels. (6) A hand places green and yellow wooden pegs into a wooden base shaped like a cactus, demonstrating a balancing game. The setting is a brightly lit nursery or playroom. (7) A wooden car track with a small yellow car zig-zagging down several levels. A baby in patterned pajamas sits nearby, watching and touching the track. (8) The camera returns to the woman from the first phase. She continues to talk enthusiastically, using hand gestures to emphasize her points.
